title: TCP connect, write, read and close against a loopback peer
purpose: Exercise a protocol boundary against a suite-owned loopback fixture.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: The fixture replies `echo:` plus the received line; the reply (11 bytes) arrives on the stream input.

notes: A single read is used; the fixture writes the whole reply with one sendall on loopback. If an implementation legitimately returns a shorter prefix, the case reports a FAIL rather than a false pass.
